description:
One published asset, with per-chain supply and an optional daily price history.

Call this after list_assets, or when the id is already known. Pass the id from an ambiguous result. Do not guess among assets that share a display ticker.

JSON is the asset card plus by_chain (chain, supply, market_cap_usd, holders where published) and history ([{date, price_usd}], newest days only, only when the price is published). Unknown id: {"error": "not_found", "query"}. Shared ticker: {"error": "ambiguous", "query", "matches": [{id, ticker, display_ticker, name, chains}]}. An announced id returns the listing with status upcoming and no figures. Units match list_assets. Price history values are US dollars per token.

history_days.description: Daily published prices to include, from 0 to 30. 0 omits history. History is included only when the price itself is published.

id.description: Asset id (slug), registry ticker, or display ticker. A shared display ticker returns an ambiguous error and the matching ids.

response_format.description: markdown (default) is a compact reading form. json is the object described below, with source numbers and omitted fields left out.

name: get_asset
